title: OJSC MMC Norilsk Nickel - proposed acquisition of assets from OMG Kokkola Pty Ltd

timeline.event: Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced decision not to oppose the merger

body_sections.Summary: OJSC MMC Norilsk Nickel - proposed acquisition of assets from OMG Kokkola Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The national market for the supply of nickel.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The assets to be acquired from OMG Kokkola include interests in several Australian nickel mines.  These mines are very small relative to both Australian and world nickel production.  As the acquisition will lead to only a small increase in Norilsk's share of the national and global nickel markets, and Norilsk will continue to face numerous competitors or varying sizes, it appears unlikely that the acquisition will lead to a substantial lessening of competition.
